title: Yellowish Chewy Peruvian Paneer Curry
description: A resinous and chewy Peruvian dish featuring paneer, nimono-simmer, and shojin-friendly ingredients, this curry is a comforting and flavorful meal option. It combines the richness of paneer with the warmth of Peruvian spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the peruvian chili paste to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cubed paneer to the pan and cook until it is lightly browned.
Add the coconut milk, turmeric, cumin, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the paneer is fully coated.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
